title: Yeh Hai Judgement - Hang Till Death
description: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shook the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

title: Majaal
description: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her. But their marriage hits rock bottom when, on several occasions, Vijay is disrespected by his in-laws.

title: Naya Kadam
description: Madhukar and Jaggu are Hitler-like tyrants who rule over a small community with an iron hand. They prefer to keep the inhabitants illiterate, so that they can continue to oppress and abuse them over time.

title: Jaan Se Pyaara
description: A cop looks after his mentally challenged twin brother and devoted mother. However, his dangerous police work gets in the way of family life, causing tragedy.

title: Satya
description: After Satya, an earnest young man who came to Mumbai, India, in search of work, is thrown in jail for a crime he didn't commit, he must delve into the depths of Mumbai's criminal underworld to survive. Fresh out of prison, he meets a beautiful singer named Vidya, who is repelled by the gangs that afflict her neighborhood. To win her heart, Satya decides to conceal his criminal dealings from her, which grows more difficult as a brutal gang war heats up.

title: Khel
description: A wealthy widow loses her son in a car accident. Years later, she hires a young man who retrieves her purse from a thief. Impressed by his honesty, she hires him, but the guy is a con who is hatching a plan to seize her property.

title: Zakhmi Aurat
description: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law into her own hands and seeks revenge by devastating means.

title: Guddu Ki Gun
description: Guddu finds himself in a quandary when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him after he cheats on her. Guddu must find true love and remain faithful to lift the curse.

title: Marshal
description: Marshal unravels the mystery of what happens when the power of science falls in the wrong hands.

title: Sikka
description: Two close friends, Vijay and Pranlal, decide to cement their friendship into a relationship.

title: International Crook
description: Superintendent of police, Rajesh, is asked to look after a police station in Goa, where he meets his old friend; Rajesh finds himself in a dilemma where he must re-evaluate his commitment to their friendship.

title: Pataakha
description: Feuding sisters realize how foolish they've been.

title: Keemat
description: Ajay and Dev feel guilty after they accidentally kill a young man. When they visit the boy's family but cannot bring themselves to speak the truth, they decide to stay and make amends in secret.
